newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 5.

text.p: Constitutional Affairs Minister G.L. Peiris says government will seek unanimous support for peace plan without diluting devolution proposals.
Former army chief General Hamilton Wanasinghe charged and freed on bail in corruption probe.
Six policemen arrested in Vavuniya in investigation into killings of two Tamil businessmen. They are alleged to have burnt the bodies of their victims on tyres.
Police arrest 10 suspected Tamil rebels in probe into arms caches found in Colombo suburb and Puttalam.
Police find explosives and ammunition near stream which runs close to Katunayake international airport.
Two Tamil rebels surrender to army in northern Jaffna after escaping from LTTE camp. Rebels say they are unhappy with Tamil rebel movement.
